items.html: But there is one difference in this, that if the main coupling at that time is for Rachel, then even though the two join and become a single Partzuf, nevertheless then Leah gives, by way of loan and borrowing, her body and her vessels to Rachel, so that she can lengthen by their means; and then that whole Partzuf is called by the name Rachel. And if the coupling is with Leah, then it is the opposite, for Rachel gives to Leah, by way of borrowing and loan, her body and her vessels, to enlarge them; and then everything is called the Partzuf of Leah. However, now it is a coupling of Leah, as is known, and she takes on loan from Rachel, as will be explained.
